features: You can now revisit past release notes anytime — look for "What's New" in the toolbar popup, the Data tab of Settings, or the "View Changelog" button on the update notification itself
Update notifications are more reliable — they now show up right away with the correct notes for what actually changed, instead of sometimes lagging or showing outdated info
Fixed the live-formatting composer (WYSIWYG) sometimes duplicating text when accepting a suggestion from Grammarly or similar grammar-checking extensions
Fixed an overflow issue when Sidebar Layout is disabled
Fixed user text color in light/dark mode — split the color settings between user and bot, and between light and dark modes
Fixed the character info bar and Sidebar Layout's Generation Settings modal being forced into dark mode regardless of the active theme
Fixed the Custom Style settings panel having no light-mode colors at all (text was unreadable)
Custom Style now supports independent Light and Dark color profiles via a switch in the settings panel, instead of one shared color set
Custom Style's Light Mode defaults now match SpicyChat's native colors, so enabling it with nothing customized is a visual no-op
Fixed WYSIWYG composer text rendering invisible (white-on-white) in Light Mode when neither Custom Style nor Classic Style is active
Fixed the composer permanently losing cursor movement and syntax highlighting after starting a new chat on the same page
Fixed a gap between the chat scrollbar and the pinned Generation Settings/Memories sidebar panel
Fixed Google Drive "Settings" sync silently excluding two Layout toggles (Selection Checkboxes on Right Side, Square Message Box Edges)
Fixed "Chat Name in Title" no longer updating the browser tab title after SpicyChat changed its own title format
Hid the stale "Hide Creator Name" setting from the UI
Updated the privacy policy
Google Drive backup/sync, compact mobile generation statistics, and the iOS WYSIWYG fix from 1.1.0
Additional stability and reliability fixes for mobile devices
Fixed the pop-up window that appears when clicking the extension icon in the toolbar

You can now use Google Drive to backup and synchronize your generation statistics, styles and settings across devices — go to the Data tab and sign in with your Google account to get started. It will ONLY affect one folder on your Google Drive, so your personal data is safe
Implemented compact generation statistics for mobile devices, under Features → Generation Statistics
Fixed Live Text Formatting (WYSIWYG) on iOS
Massive stability and reliability fixes for mobile devices under the hood
